CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_entity` (
    `id` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `actiontype` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `relatedid` int(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_edit` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `action` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `crmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationdetails` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_create` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `action` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `crmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationdetails` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `frommodule` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `fromcrmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_share` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `action` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `crmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationdetails` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `shareto_userids` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `remove_userids` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_delete` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `action` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    `actiontype` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `crmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationdetails` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `mergedcrmids` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_deletedrecords` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `crmid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `keyinfo` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `hyperlink_content` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_import` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `status` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `importnum` Int(20) NOT NULL,
    `failedimportnum` int(20) DEFAULT NULL,
    `importresult` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `duplicatefield` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
    `importtype` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `starttime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `finishtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `importfilename` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_export` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `status` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `exportnum` Int(20) NOT NULL,
    `exportresult` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `starttime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `finishtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `exporttype` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)

    `id` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

    `actiontype` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `relatedid` int(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_edit` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL,

    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,

    `operationdetails` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,

    `frommodule` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `fromcrmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_share` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL,

    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `crmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationdetails` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `shareto_userids` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `remove_userids` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_delete` (
    `id` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `userid` int(20) NOT NULL,
    `action` varchar(100) NOT NULL,

    `module` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ,
    `crmid` int(20) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationdetails` text(0) DEFAULT NULL,
    `operationtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
    `mergedcrmids` text(0) DEFAULT NULL ,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ld_crmlog_deletedrecords` (

SET @this_sql="SELECT
	CASE
		WHEN yingna_total<=0 THEN 0.00
		WHEN yingna_total<36000 THEN ROUND(yingna_total*0.03-yina_total,2)
		WHEN yingna_total<144000 THEN ROUND(yingna_total*0.1-2520-yina_total,2)
		WHEN yingna_total<300000 THEN ROUND(yingna_total*0.2-16920-yina_total,2)
		WHEN yingna_total<420000 THEN ROUND(yingna_total*0.25-31920-yina_total,2)
		WHEN yingna_total<660000 THEN ROUND(yingna_total*0.3-52920-yina_total,2)
		WHEN yingna_total<960000 THEN ROUND(yingna_total*0.35-85920-yina_total,2)
		WHEN yingna_total>=960000 THEN ROUND(yingna_total*0.45-181920-yina_total,2)
	END AS tmp_value
FROM (
	SELECT
		SUM(yingna_total)+'{c}'-'{d}'-'{e}' AS yingna_total,
		SUM(yina_total) AS yina_total
	FROM (
		SELECT
			SUM(IFNULL(pretax_salary_total,0)-IFNULL(insurance_subtotal,0)-IFNULL(additional_subtotal,0)-IFNULL(tax_startpoint,0)) AS yingna_total,
			SUM(IFNULL(individual_income_tax,0)) AS yina_total
		FROM ld_salary
		WHERE deleted=0
			AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
			AND LEFT(salary_period,4)=LEFT('{a}',4)
			AND RIGHT(salary_period,2)<RIGHT('{a}',2)
			AND smownerid='{b}'
		UNION
		SELECT 0 AS yingna_total,0 AS yina_total
	) a
) a";
